title: Companion Travel Calendar: Advance Booking, Blackout Periods and Monthly Trip Limits
content:
For every product of Crestline Companion Certificates and Passes, a companion trip must be booked a minimum number of calendar days before its first departure, no companion flight may depart inside the product's blackout periods, and only a set number of trips may have their outbound travel date in one calendar month.

| Product | Booked at least this many calendar days before the first departure | Blackout periods (inclusive, repeating every year) | Most companion trips whose outbound travel date falls in one calendar month | Last companion flight must also depart on or before the book-by date |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Crestline Companion Certificate Main Cabin | 14 | 24 November to 30 November; 19 December to 4 January | 1 | no |
| Crestline Companion Certificate Main Plus | 14 | 24 November to 30 November; 19 December to 4 January | 1 | no |
| Crestline Companion Certificate Premium Economy | 7 | 24 November to 30 November | 1 | no |
| Crestline Companion Certificate First | 7 | 24 November to 30 November | 1 | no |
| Crestline Companion Pass Semiannual | 0 | none | 2 | yes |
| Crestline Companion Pass Annual | 0 | none | 4 | yes |

## Notes on the calendar

- A blackout period is inclusive at both ends: for a Main Cabin certificate a companion flight departing on 30 November or on 4 January falls inside a blackout; one departing on 1 December or 5 January does not.
- The winter blackout of the Main Cabin and Main Plus certificates runs across the turn of the year, from 19 December to 4 January.
- The two passes have no advance-booking minimum (0 days) and no blackout periods, but every companion flight on a pass must depart on or before the pass's book-by date.
- For the certificates the book-by date limits when the trip is booked, not when it is flown.

**Hypothetical examples.** A Crestline Companion Certificate Premium Economy trip whose first departure is on the 20th of a month may be booked up to the 13th of that month (7 calendar days before) and not later. A Crestline Companion Pass Annual holder may book up to 4 trips with outbound travel in March; a Pass Semiannual holder up to 2.
